points.name: apps.media.volume.minus_icon
points.interpretation: The page sets media/minus.bin on the decrease button.

points.name: apps.media.volume.plus_icon
points.interpretation: The page sets media/plus.bin on the increase button.

points.name: apps.media.volume.minus_register
points.interpretation: Registers C51E2EC with event filter 7. The handler reduces the volume in steps of 10 and can send a media volume command.

points.name: apps.media.volume.plus_register
points.interpretation: Registers C51E394 with event filter 7. The handler increases volume in steps of 10 and may show a sound-level prompt.

points.name: apps.media.volume.bar_icon
points.interpretation: The increase callback sets media/volume_bar.bin when the previous volume is zero.

create_analysis: The descriptor points to 0x0c51edc5. At 0x0c51edc4 the Thumb entry checks R1, then allocates 12 bytes and writes the pointer to 0x20110b3c at 0x0c51edda. IDA did not recover a function, so the entry and calls were inspected as instructions. The observed page wrapper ignores create return; the named contract exposes no result.
evidence: The media manifest registers the page descriptor. Destroy unregisters the display callback, frees and clears the state slot, then deletes UI objects. The minus and plus icons register separate callbacks; handlers bound volume in ten-unit steps and route media volume commands.
scope: The listed image and registration calls only; this does not intercept all media volume changes, sound-limit prompts, remote device behavior, or volume backend APIs.
limitations: Changing callbacks may bypass a sound-level prompt or leave UI and actual volume inconsistent. The state slot is not a thread barrier and the create return ABI is not independently confirmed. Device behavior and recovery remain unverified.
